    • scopeData

      Metadata.Builder scopeData(PropertyMap scopeData)
      Add device property data. This method will remove all previously added scope data from this builder.
      Specified by:
      scopeData in interface Metadata.MetadataBuilder
      Parameters:
      scopeData - device properties; keys should be in "DeviceLabel-PropertyName" format, and values should be strings (numbers will be converted to strings)
